name: EU Company Register to Google Sheets
description: Look up every company row across seven national registers with the original Apify Actor, wait for complete results, then update or append the selected registration fields in Google Sheets.
requirements: Apify connection with access to gubidonius/company-registry-lookup and its run/dataset APIs
Google Sheets connection with read/write access to the same spreadsheet on all sheet actions
A Companies worksheet with unique contiguous text headers including company and a company name or registration number on every nonempty input row
Review official register records before making business decisions; no live company verification is included

source.path: Google_Drive_and_Google_Sheets/Enrich a Google Sheet of companies with EU business register data.json
